preconditions.description: The length of s_1 must be between 1 and 100.

The length of virus must be between 1 and 100.
All characters in s_1 must be uppercase English letters.
All characters in s_2 must be uppercase English letters.
All characters in virus must be uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' or virus not in stdout
postconditions.description: The output must either be '0' or a subsequence that does not contain the virus as a substring.

postconditions.expression: any(c in stdout for c in s_1) and any(c in stdout for c in s_2)
postconditions.description: The output must be a common subsequence of s_1 and s_2.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == max(len(subseq) for subseq in common_subsequences if virus not in subseq)
postconditions.description: The output must be the longest common subsequence of s_1 and s_2 that does not contain the virus as a substring.
